title: Horses can't throw up. Ever 🐴
caption:
What goes in, stays in. Here's why that's dangerous 🐴⚠️
Save this if you love horses 👇
first_comment: Did you know horses can't vomit? 🐴👇
sources: Merck Veterinary Manual: horses rarely if ever vomit (strong lower oesophageal sphincter, angle of entry into the stomach); colic and gastric rupture risk
American Association of Equine Practitioners, colic signs (pawing, rolling, looking at the flank) and calling the vet
